name: Input Buffer
description: Snaps early or late clicks to the nearest timing that survives, within a set number of physics steps. Safe mode is built in.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the input buffer on or off. While it's on in a level, nothing from that level session is saved (built-in safe mode).

steps.name: Buffer steps
steps.description: How far an input may be moved, earlier or later, in physics steps. 1 step = 1/240 s (about 4.2 ms). 0 turns the buffer off.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (steps)
lookahead.description: How far ahead each prediction runs for tap gamemodes (cube, ball, UFO, spider, swing). Higher catches deaths further after the click, but is slower. Hold gamemodes (ship, wave, robot) use a short fixed window.

debug-log.name: Debug log
debug-log.description: Writes every decision (delayed / moved back / left as-is) to the Geode console. Turn this on when testing and send me the log if something feels off.
